description: Update the driver-app (apps/driver-app) to use the real state machine. HomeScreen polls for new REQUESTED trips and accepts them via the API. ActiveTripScreen drives the trip through DRIVER_ARRIVING→ARRIVED→IN_PROGRESS→COMPLETED. DriverAPI client methods already exist and map cleanly to the new endpoints. This feature depends on FEAT-001 (API endpoints) but is independent of FEAT-002 (passenger-app).
steps: 1. Update apps/driver-app/src/services/api/DriverAPI.ts: change acceptTrip() to POST /v1/trips/:tripId/accept (was /driver/trips/:tripId/accept); change declineTrip() to POST /v1/trips/:tripId/cancel with body { cancellation_reason: reason }; change arrivedAtPickup() to POST /v1/trips/:tripId/driver-arriving; add a new method driverArrived(tripId) that calls POST /v1/trips/:tripId/arrived; change startTrip() to POST /v1/trips/:tripId/start; change completeTrip(tripId, actualFare) to POST /v1/trips/:tripId/complete with body { final_fare: actualFare, payment_method: 'cash' }; change cancelTrip() to POST /v1/trips/:tripId/cancel with body { cancellation_reason: reason }; add getTripState(tripId) that calls GET /v1/trips/:tripId/state; update getTripRequests() to GET /v1/trips/available/nearby with query params latitude, longitude (pass last known location from LocationService or a default). Also update APIClient base URL to read from process.env or keep the vercel URL — no change needed there.

2. Update apps/driver-app/src/screens/main/HomeScreen.tsx: add a polling useEffect that calls DriverAPI.getTripRequests() every 8 seconds when driver status is 'available' (not when offline or on-trip). Replace the one-time loadData() call with this interval. When status changes to 'offline' or 'on-trip', clear the interval. handleAcceptTrip: call DriverAPI.acceptTrip(tripId) — already does this; on success navigate to ActiveTrip screen with the tripId. handleDeclineTrip: call DriverAPI.declineTrip(tripId) — already calls this; on success filter the trip from local list as before. Add a useEffect that checks for an active trip on mount (DriverAPI.getActiveTrip()) and if found immediately navigates to ActiveTrip — this handles the case where the app restarts mid-trip. Show a loading skeleton while the first poll is in flight.

3. Update apps/driver-app/src/screens/trip/ActiveTripScreen.tsx: replace the static hardcoded trip with real data. The screen receives tripId via route.params (already typed as { tripId: string } in HomeStackParamList). On mount, fetch GET /v1/trips/:tripId to load trip details (passenger name, pickup, destination, fare). Add a polling useEffect calling DriverAPI.getTripState(tripId) every 5 seconds; if server returns CANCELLED, show an Alert 'Passenger cancelled the trip' and navigate back to HomeMain. Map the trip's local status state to: 'accepted' (ACCEPTED/DRIVER_ARRIVING), 'arrived' (ARRIVED), 'in_progress' (IN_PROGRESS), 'completed' (COMPLETED). Replace handleStartTrip() to call DriverAPI.arrivedAtPickup(tripId) → transitions to DRIVER_ARRIVING; rename to handleDrivingToPickup for clarity but keep the same button label. Replace handleArrived() to call DriverAPI.driverArrived(tripId) → transitions to ARRIVED. Add handleStartTrip() that calls DriverAPI.startTrip(tripId) → transitions to IN_PROGRESS. Replace confirmPayment() logic to call DriverAPI.completeTrip(tripId, fare) → transitions to COMPLETED; on success navigate to HomeMain. Show the correct buttons based on current local status: ACCEPTED shows 'I've Arrived at Pickup'; ARRIVED shows 'Start Trip'; IN_PROGRESS shows 'Complete Trip'. Add elapsed timer only during IN_PROGRESS (already present, keep it). Add an SOS button that calls POST /v1/tracking/sos (existing endpoint if it exists, otherwise just fires an Alert). Update the status display to show the human-readable server state.
4. Type-check: cd apps/driver-app && npx tsc --noEmit — zero errors.
acceptance_criteria: DriverAPI methods map to the correct v1/trips/:tripId/{action} endpoints.
HomeScreen polls for available trips every 8 seconds when driver is online.
HomeScreen navigates to ActiveTrip immediately if an active trip exists on mount.
ActiveTripScreen loads real trip data from server.
ActiveTripScreen shows the correct action button for each server state (ACCEPTED/DRIVER_ARRIVING/ARRIVED/IN_PROGRESS).
Completing a trip calls POST /v1/trips/:tripId/complete and navigates back to HomeMain.
If the server returns CANCELLED (passenger cancelled), the driver's screen shows an alert and returns home.
npx tsc --noEmit in apps/driver-app emits zero errors.
